title: Demonstratives in the singular genitive
summary: Use tämän, tuon or sen before a singular genitive noun: tämän talon ovi (“the door of this house”).
prerequisiteSkills: Adjective agreement in the singular genitive
objectives: Use tämän, tuon or sen before a singular genitive noun: tämän talon ovi (“the door of this house”).

sections.title: Meaning and pattern
paragraphs: A demonstrative identifies which noun is meant. Its case and number agree with that noun, while its reference distinguishes near, farther away, and already mentioned.
Use tämä → tämän (“this”), tuo → tuon (“that” being pointed out farther away), se → sen (“the/that” already mentioned).
The noun genitives and surrounding head nouns are provided. Reference cues choose among demonstratives; the genitive ending alone does not choose the reference.
keyPoints: Keep the reference shown in the question.
